reviews.feedback: cmd/tally/main.go:110 prints the full demo token to stdout (`fmt.Fprintf(os.Stdout, "demo API key (shown once): %s\n", k.Token)`). The task says the full token appears only in the POST /v1/api-keys and POST /v1/invites/accept answers and nowhere else, including logs; the old code logged it and this moves it to another output. Remove that line, keep the api_key_last4 log entry, drop the now-unused fmt import if nothing else needs it, and have the demo key be created through the API instead.
